verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own llms.txt says users can 'Connect MailerSend directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini.' That is a first-party capability for driving the product through natural-language assistants, but it is a single thin marketing line, with no documentation of which operations are exposed or how commands are interpreted. The llms.txt file itself only helps machines read the docs and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented connector or MCP setup, the list of operations available via natural language, any native in-app natural-language interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
